rec.name: Cart Tiered Rewards Progress Bar (Free Shipping + 3 Free Gifts)

what.text: A progress bar at the top of the cart drawer. It shows cart value against several reward thresholds: free shipping first, then up to three free-gift tiers. Each tier is marked by an icon (truck for shipping, gift boxes for gifts) on the bar. The bar fills as the cart grows, and a message below states the next step, e.g. 'Only €43.05 left for free shipping' or 'Your shipping is now free. €11.20 left until your free gift!'. Unlocked tiers show a success message. In the customer's setup the bar only visualises the tiers. Adding the free gift to the cart is handled by the customer's existing app, not by this section.

why.text: The goal-gradient effect: people accelerate toward a goal the closer they get. A visible bar with a concrete 'X € left' amount makes the next reward feel within reach, which nudges shoppers to add items and raises AOV. Stacking several milestones (free shipping, then three gifts) gives repeated small goals and rewards. Instant success messages reinforce each win. Showing every tier upfront also communicates the full value of the offer.

how.text: Build it as a theme section/snippet rendered in the cart drawer above the line items. Take the cart total and compare it with merchant-defined thresholds (customer example: €60 free shipping, €79 / €89 / €109 gifts). Icon positions are calculated dynamically from the highest threshold, so the bar and icons always stay aligned with the real values. Icon spacing was adjusted by about 10px so close tiers (e.g. the 2nd and 3rd gifts) don't overlap. Progress messages (before a tier, after each tier is reached, and a final message) are editable text in the theme settings. Free-gift add-to-cart logic can be turned off when an external app handles it. The merchant can change thresholds, for instance during sales, without code. The section was extended from 2 to 3 gift tiers.

items: Gift tier 1, 2 and 3 thresholds (amounts, editable for sales)
Progress message before each tier, with an amount placeholder
Success message for free shipping and for each gift tier
Final success message once all tiers are unlocked
Toggle for the built-in free-gift add-to-cart function (off when an external app is used)

dependencies.text: Cart drawer in the theme. Theme settings for thresholds and messages. For this customer, an existing third-party free-gift app handles adding the gifts, so the section must not duplicate that. Without the app, the section's own free-gift logic needs gift products set up (3 test gift products were created). Currency formatting follows the store's market (EUR).

items: Share of carts reaching the free shipping threshold
Share of carts reaching each gift tier
